data.name: Many Lives
data.description: If you are killed, you may automatically reincarnate (as the spell) 1 day later.  You appear in a safe location within 1 mile of your previous body. At will for the next 7 days, you can sense the presence of your remains as if using locate object as a spell-like ability. If you are killed during these 7 days, you remain dead and do not reincarnate. The many lives ability does not function you are slain by a death effect.  You cannot be raised from the dead orresurrected, though you can be reincarnated.
